name: T-5RZ Onslaught Droid
description: The T-5RZ Onslaught Droid was a battle droid that was utilized by the Coronas, a criminal gang that worked for the corrupt Corellian politician Harmon Torvix. During the Galactic War, the T-5RZ Onslaught Droid was destroyed in the Black Hole region of Corellia by Imperial forces that salvaged the droid's memory core.
